profile.headline: DevOps Engineer
profile.summary:
Steven is a DevOps Engineer seeking a challenging and rewarding remote or onsite position to lend his technical skills to help build, support, and maximize a successful organization's critical cloud and on-premises infrastructure, services, and reliability practices. As a United States Air Force veteran and former aviation professional Steven will bring years of problem solving and practiced attention to detail to any organization. 

Off the job Steven's passion is working as a Voice Actor and has equipped a professional home studio with full remote recording capabilities. To unwind Steven is an avid motorcycle enthusiast.
